recordingProfileCapture.artifactIntegrity: all 15 implementation images and 15 measurement records matched manifest byte counts and SHA-256 values
recordingProfileCapture.note: The Nx capture target ran both the app and E2E typecheck prerequisites before completing all 15 states. Every state required a real recording-desktop full-motion WebGL canvas, seed 43117, render readiness, no observed context loss, and an observed screen-composition measurement. The 11 source-applicable copy states, all 12 source-applicable route states, all 7 source-observed landmark states, all 5 source-applicable field states, the independent field-contact center, and journey-exit additionally carry structural evidence records. The source contract now uses composition as the primary structure for landing and landing-idle, and field profile as the primary structure for field-approach and field-pulse-a; all 15 source-primary structures are observed. The four corresponding landmark fields remain honestly blocked secondary annotations. Three implementation field profiles are observed while preview and approach fail the unchanged source-pixel quality gate. Four transferable landmarks and two red routes are observed; world-reveal and landing-idle remain route-blocked because localhost renders no qualifying red route pixels; eight cyan-family states now use renderer-independent localhost classifiers. Three source-mask landmarks are compared with renderer-independent implementation masks; source masks remain reference-only and never classify implementation pixels. Runtime errors, context loss, invalid structural records, and missing composition evidence are hard failures, and the complete size/SHA-256 manifest is published atomically.

currentLiveProfileProbe.qualification: Tablet and mobile are browser emulations, not physical-device or performance evidence. Main-thread context-loss events were monitored; worker and OffscreenCanvas context-loss state remains unknown.

fieldTileProfileEvidence.qualification: The same bright-neutral predicate and component-shape gates measure full visible tile tops in both rasters. Clipped, activated, pulse-recolored, and bloom-obscured tiles are not inferred. Preview and approach are blocked because the implementation has no qualifying field components in the source-defined ROIs.

fieldContactCenterEvidence.qualification: The shared chroma predicate measures only the saturated field-contact center tile. It is independent structural evidence and does not replace the authoritative source-tied tile-plus-standing-figure semantic landmark union.

edgeSupportIou.qualification: Sobel edge-support overlap is diagnostic and cannot satisfy filled-silhouette acceptance.

landmarkEvidence.qualification: The loader, world-reveal, and field-pulse-b chroma masks are eligible silhouette evidence and fail the locked minimum. Arrival remains blocked because its transferable measurement observes edges rather than a filled semantic silhouette.

routeEvidence.qualification: The centerline metric is exact symmetric Euclidean Hausdorff distance over deterministic skeletons of the visible selected route-core masks. It includes parallel rails and branches without inferring a hidden renderer spline.

comparison.reason: The whole four-row landing/journey DOM ladder passes all 13 applicable state contracts; loader-mark and world-reveal have no applicable DOM profile. The unmasked full-frame raster is only a preliminary diagnostic and passes 1 of 15 states. Shared source/implementation algorithms now measure all 15 composition records, all 11 source-applicable copy envelopes, all 12 source-applicable route states, four transferable landmark states, all five source-applicable field tile profiles, the independent field-contact center tile, and the journey-exit boundary; three additional source-mask landmarks carry renderer-independent implementation-mask comparisons. Composition is the primary source structure for landing and landing-idle, while field profile is primary for field-approach and field-pulse-a, so all 15 source-primary structures are observed without fabricating four subjective landmark boxes. Those landmark fields remain blocked secondary evidence. Composition passes 191/285 checks, copy bounds pass 18/44, field evidence passes 8/27, contact-center evidence passes 0/5, landmark evidence passes 13/35, ten observed route cores pass 15/70, and the boundary passes 4/4. Preview and approach field profiles are implementation quality blocks; the three observed field masks fail the 0.90 IoU minimum at 0.4268, 0.3845, and 0.1771. The independent contact-center silhouette fails at 0.1277 without replacing the full semantic union. All ten route centerline Hausdorff distances fail the 0.75% short-edge maximum, ranging from 9.7675% to 93.9334%. Loader, world-reveal, and field-pulse-b silhouette IoUs fail at 0.3987, 0.6460, and 0.3548. Activation-route, activation-contact, and field-contact independently classified landmark silhouettes fail at 0.7009, 0.6498, and 0.1878; arrival's 0.0261 value is edge-support evidence only. World-reveal and landing-idle remain route-blocked because localhost renders no qualifying red route pixels; eight cyan-family states now use renderer-independent localhost classifiers. Structural accuracy is 0 pass / 8 fail / 7 blocked. Neither preliminary raster, partial geometry success, nor DOM success confers final visual acceptance.

blockingEvidence.issue: Deterministic recording measurement resolves 7 landmarks, 12 visible route cores, 11 copy-ink envelopes, 5 field tile profiles, 1 independent saturated field-contact center tile, 15 fixed-grid screen-space composition proxies, and 1 section boundary. All 15 source-primary structures are observed: composition is primary for landing and landing-idle, and field profile is primary for field-approach and field-pulse-a. Their four landmark fields remain blocked secondary annotations and do not block the source-primary gate. Shared renderer-independent algorithms now measure screen composition for all 15 manifest-verified implementation captures, copy ink for all 11 source-applicable captures, route records for all 12 source-applicable captures, transferable landmarks for 4 states, field profiles for all 5 applicable states, the contact-center tile, and the journey-exit boundary; the 3 source-mask landmarks use separate renderer-independent implementation classifiers. Composition passes 191/285 checks, copy bounds pass 18/44, field evidence passes 8/27, contact-center evidence passes 0/5, landmark evidence passes 13/35, ten observed route cores pass 15/70, and boundary bounds pass 4/4. Preview and approach field profiles are implementation quality blocks; field-contact, pulse-a, and pulse-b field-mask IoUs fail the 0.90 minimum at 0.4268, 0.3845, and 0.1771. The independent field-contact center fails all five checks with 0.1277 IoU and remains separate from the full landmark union, whose independently classified implementation silhouette fails at 0.1878 IoU. All ten visible-core route centerline Hausdorff distances fail the 0.75% short-edge maximum, ranging from 9.7675% to 93.9334%. The loader, world-reveal, and field-pulse-b silhouette IoUs fail the 0.90 minimum at 0.3987, 0.6460, and 0.3548. The activation-route, activation-contact, and field-contact independently classified silhouettes fail at 0.7009, 0.6498, and 0.1878. Arrival's 0.0261 Sobel overlap is edge support only, not a filled silhouette. World-reveal and landing-idle remain route-blocked because localhost renders no qualifying red route pixels; eight cyan-family states now use renderer-independent localhost classifiers. The faded arrival-travel copy, the clipped/header-overlapped journey-exit copy, the arrival silhouette, two absent early-red route states, and additional source observables remain blocked. The recording cannot expose a 3D camera transform, so the comparator requires observed screen-space composition evidence while preserving camera position/quaternion as unknown. The repository-owned semantic masks remain tied to exact source-frame and mask hashes and are accepted for reference refinement only. Their machine-enforced contract forbids the source masks themselves from classifying implementation pixels or conferring structural or final visual acceptance; the comparison becomes eligible only because localhost is classified independently. The current implementation passes all 13 applicable live DOM contracts, but neither DOM success nor implementation captures can substitute for missing source measurements.
The procedural world, route projection, static cameras, materials, lighting, effects, and geometry have not passed state-specific structural and visual tolerances.
Loader, landing packets, field pulse cadence, pointer-trail appearance, and arrival timing remain comparison candidates rather than accepted source matches.

The Phase 19 acceptance performance run remains unrun on locked hardware. An earlier development software-renderer diagnostic exceeded frame-time, long-task, and mobile CLS budgets and is not acceptance evidence.

acceptance.reason: The current architecture, deterministic controls, repeat capture, genuine desktop/mobile convergence matrix, and manifest integrity pass their local Phase 5 gate. Ordered acceptance remains held at Phase 1 because two faded/clipped source copy states, the arrival silhouette, two absent early-red routes, and additional source observables remain unmeasured. All 15 source-primary structures are now observed; the four previously overloaded landmark requirements are reclassified to composition or field profile, while their landmark fields remain blocked secondary evidence. Shared algorithms now measure all 15 source/implementation composition records, all 11 source-applicable implementation copy envelopes, transferable landmarks for 4 states, route records for all 12 source-applicable states, field profiles for all 5 source-applicable states, the independent field-contact center tile, and both journey-exit boundaries; composition passes 191/285 checks, copy bounds pass 18/44, field evidence passes 8/27, contact-center evidence passes 0/5, landmark evidence passes 13/35, ten observed route cores pass 15/70, and boundary bounds pass 4/4. Preview and approach field profiles are implementation quality blocks; the three observed field masks fail the 0.90 IoU minimum at 0.4268, 0.3845, and 0.1771. The separately measured field-contact center fails all five checks with 0.1277 IoU. All ten observed route centerlines fail the 0.75% maximum, ranging from 9.7675% to 93.9334%. Loader, world-reveal, and field-pulse-b silhouettes fail at 0.3987, 0.6460, and 0.3548. Activation-route, activation-contact, and field-contact independently classified silhouettes fail at 0.7009, 0.6498, and 0.1878; arrival's 0.0261 overlap remains edge support only. Unknown 3D camera transforms remain documented without serving as an impossible source gate. The comparator separately reports only 1/15 preliminary raster states passing and structural accuracy at 0 pass / 8 fail / 7 blocked, despite a 13/13 applicable whole-ladder DOM pass; final hero acceptance is therefore blocked.
